# Open apparatus fixtures

- `sbl-phm.xml`: exact Faithlife/SBLGNT apparatus XML for Philemon, commit d7f35adca9ec410e1d1499c63b4dd989d76c8d4d. Michael W. Holmes (ed.); © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software, CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/Faithlife/SBLGNT
- `oshb-ruth.xml`: exact Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible `wlc/Ruth.xml`, commit 3d15126fb1ef74867fc1434be1942e837932691f. Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible Project, annotations CC BY 4.0; WLC text public domain. https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb

Bytes are checked against the declared Git blob SHA and size. Fixtures retain source spelling, Unicode sequences and whitespace. Other test records are explicitly synthetic format examples, not historical apparatus claims. No private research records are included in these public tests.
